rules.source: Loi n° 78-17 du 6 janvier 1978 relative à l'informatique, aux fichiers et aux libertés (loi Informatique et Libertés) — https://www.cnil.fr/fr/la-loi-informatique-et-libertes
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary of CNIL page: the CNIL publishes the consolidated text of loi 78-17 of 6 January 1978; Article 1 states information technology must serve every citizen and must not undermine human identity, human rights, privacy or individual and public freedoms; the CNIL notes the Légifrance version prevails if texts differ. (Not fetched in full.)

rules.source: Loi n° 2004-575 du 21 juin 2004 pour la confiance dans l'économie numérique (LCEN), article 6 — https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/loda/id/JORFTEXT000000801164
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary of Légifrance result listing: article 6 sets the hosting-provider liability regime; hosts must hold and retain data allowing identification of anyone who contributed to content creation (failure criminally sanctioned per the summary: one year and EUR 250,000); Légifrance shows the text last modified by LOI n°2026-813 of 24 August 2026 (in force 26 August 2026). Full consolidated text not retrieved.

aliases: système de traitement automatisé de données
rules.source: Code pénal, article 323-1 (chapitre III, atteintes aux systèmes de traitement automatisé de données, arts 323-1 à 323-8) — https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/codes/article_lc/LEGIARTI000030939438/
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary of Légifrance: art. 323-1 penalises fraudulently accessing or remaining in all or part of an automated data processing system — three years and EUR 100,000 base; five years and EUR 150,000 if data is deleted/altered or system operation disrupted; seven years and EUR 300,000 for State-run personal data systems; version in force since 26/01/2023 (LOI 2023-22). Page itself not fetched.

aliases: loi sur la liberté de la presse
rules.source: Loi du 29 juillet 1881 sur la liberté de la presse, articles 23, 24, 29 — https://www.assemblee-nationale.fr/dyn/16/questions/QANR5L16QE10456.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary (Assemblée nationale written question and Sénat documents): defamation (art. 29 al. 1) and insult (art. 29 al. 2) are press offences committed through the means listed in art. 23; art. 24 covers provocation to crimes and public provocation to discrimination, hatred or violence (aggravating circumstance added by the law of 24 August 2021). Consolidated text not retrieved.

rules.source: Loi du 29 juillet 1881 sur la liberté de la presse, articles 24 and 24 bis — https://www.assemblee-nationale.fr/dyn/16/questions/QANR5L16QE10456.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: art. 24 covers provocation to hatred, discrimination or violence (alinéas 7 and 8, aggravated by the law of 24 August 2021) and apology; art. 24 bis covers contesting or minimising crimes against humanity. Consolidated text not retrieved.

rules.source: Loi n° 2024-449 du 21 mai 2024 visant à sécuriser et réguler l'espace numérique (SREN) — https://better-internet-for-kids.europa.eu/en/rules-guidelines/law-no-2024-449-may-21-2024-aimed-securing-and-regulating-digital-space
rules.retrieved_snippet: Secondary-source search summary (no Légifrance page retrieved): law promulgated 21 May 2024, in force since 23 May 2024, aligns French law with the DSA (Reg. 2022/2065); gives Arcom the task of setting minimum technical requirements for age verification on pornographic sites; includes cloud-switching provisions. Verify on Légifrance.

rules.source: Ordonnance n° 2019-1015 du 2 octobre 2019 réformant la régulation des jeux d'argent et de hasard — https://twobirds.com/en/insights/2019/france/publication-de-l-ordonnance-2019-1015
rules.retrieved_snippet: Secondary law-firm summary (Bird & Bird, CMS; no official page retrieved): ordinance published 3 October 2019 under the PACTE law, effective 1 January 2020, created the Autorité nationale des jeux (ANJ) replacing ARJEL and strengthened sanctions. Verify on Légifrance.
